preprocessing: Input tensor contract: Raw [0.0, 255.0] float32 pixels. An internal Keras model layer tf.keras.applications.mobilenet_v3.preprocess_input scales values to [-1, 1] internally prior to MobileNetV3 feature extraction.
dataset_source: New Plant Diseases Dataset (Augmented 87K, Solanaceae Partition)

field_evaluation_plantdoc.notes: Evaluated on independent unaugmented outdoor images with complex backgrounds, multiple overlapping leaves, and direct sunlight glare.
field_evaluation_plantdoc.botanical_domain_gap_analysis: PlantDoc images capture whole plants from 1-2 meters away with soil, weeds, sky, and inter-leaf shadowing, contrasting with macro photography. When uncalibrated field images are evaluated without gating, dark soil and shadow artifacts trigger false necrotic lesion activations.
field_evaluation_plantdoc.dual_stage_uncertainty_mitigation: When KRISHI-DRISHTI Dual-Stage Uncertainty Gating is applied (Foliar Plausibility Ratio >= 0.12 and Shannon Entropy H <= 1.45 nats), 68.4% of out-of-distribution and ambiguous PlantDoc frames are flagged as 'UNCERTAIN / CONSULT AGRONOMIST', preventing confident misclassifications and wrong chemical applications in the field.
